elen (auditor): Hi all, need a tight evidence bundle for RBAC change to infra/archiver-sa at ~2026-05-05T11:07:00Z. We saw a KMS Decrypt alert at 11:09. Please provide RBAC delta, KMS decrypts, and any correlated S3 GETs in 11:00-11:20 UTC.

kai: Copy. We'll slice kube-apiserver audit + IRSA mapping, CloudTrail Decrypts filtered by alias/redwood-prod-*, and S3 access rows. Will redact object keys.

mendez: Commands: kubectl get events --all-namespaces -o json --field-selector involvedObject.name=archiver-binding | jq '.' > rbac_slice.json
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=Decrypt --start-time 2026-05-05T11:00:00Z --end-time 2026-05-05T11:20:00Z > decrypts.json
aws s3api select-object-content --bucket redwood-access-logs --key 2026/05/05/11/logs.gz --expression "SELECT s._1, s._7, s._10 WHERE s._1 BETWEEN '2026-05-05T11:00:00Z' AND '2026-05-05T11:20:00Z'" --expression-type SQL --output json > s3_reads.json

evidence-bot: Preparing package: evpkg_6265432100_20260505.zip. Will include manifest.txt, rbac_slice.json, decrypts.json, s3_reads.json, correlation_note.md, redaction_log.txt. Presigned link valid 7d.

elen (auditor): Please annotate correlation_note.md with a 1-line conclusion per decrypt (related/unrelated + why). If ambiguous mark "needs forensics".

kai: Understood. ETA 25m. I'll ping when uploaded. :thumbsup:

evidence-bot: Upload complete: s3://redwood-compliance/evidence/evpkg_6265432100_20260505.zip (presigned https://presigned.example/evpkg/6265432100). sha256:9f2c1a...

elen (auditor): Downloading now. Thanks team — will request follow-up if we need deeper logs.
